_comment: Instance bank for the week-7 studio. Values are taken VERBATIM from week-07-dpll-sat.ipynb. No randomness, no seed: propositional instances are exact, not sampled. CNFs use the DIMACS int convention (positive n = variable n, negative = its negation); here P=1, Q=2, R=3.

modus_ponens.note: {P->Q, P} entails Q; does not entail ¬Q

affirming_consequent.note: {P->Q, Q} does NOT entail P -- the warm-up poll fallacy
